violated_contract: Creating a checkout session does not prove that the browser opened checkout. A refused new-tab launch must keep the purchase surface retryable and must not install success-return behavior or dismiss the offer as though checkout opened.
canonical_prevention: Check the browser launch result at the shared checkout boundary. On a null handle or launch exception, retain the selected plan and show a recoverable popup instruction. Dismiss the offer and install the return refresh only after a launch succeeds.
